description: Digital forensics capabilities for incident investigation are not established. This signal indicates that incident root cause analysis and evidence preservation may not be possible.
applicability: Applicable to Level 3 environments requiring forensic capabilities. Includes forensic tools, evidence handling procedures, and chain of custody processes.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through forensic capability assessment, tool inventory review, and evidence handling procedure verification.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 - System and Communications Protection
32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
